notes: Positive reduction means a lower candidate value. Counts such as mounted editors are observations, not optimization scores.
Streaming duration includes the wait for final visible content. Fixed-deadline traffic is retained in the raw report.
Frame gaps and driver DOM readiness are not INP. Linux CPU throttling is not an M2 Air simulation.
History decoded bytes include captured requests and responses. They are not compressed network transfer.

All twelve samples passed final visible-marker and stored tick-count checks. Two baseline streaming samples had 59 HTTP 503 errors in total and needed ten post-window verification retries. These samples remain in every paired summary.
The candidate streamed more incremental store updates. Counts alone do not establish the cause of the frame-gap regression.
Cold readiness varied in both directions. One candidate streaming sample took 85.5 seconds through final visible content; it remains included.

provenance.networkIsolation: Separate Linux user/network namespace with loopback; CPU resources remain shared.
